title: Ask skill: teach withheldFields and top-N aggregate (orderBy, limit, totalGroups)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWDsbbJizuYnDwBxT8

Follow-up of #35137 (PR #35179), from L1-b's nit 2 (comment 6977289014 on #35179). PR #35179 adds `withheldFields` and a one-sentence note to `query_records` and `get_record` results when field-level security withheld a field the caller's served schema shows. The served ask skill does not teach the member yet, so a model may still call such a field blank.

## Change

`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, section 4 "Fallback: object queries", gains one bullet (wording from the #35137 dev report 6976419490):

> - `withheldFields` on a `query_records` or `get_record` answer names fields that exist but are hidden from you: say they are not visible to you, never that they are empty.

A second line for the same section, from #35144 (PR #35193, dev report 6980284856): after the bullet that begins "Use `aggregate_records` for a count, sum, average or breakdown." and its sentence "`truncated: true` on its answer means groups were cut off: say so.", add:

> For a top or bottom N, pass `orderBy` (an aggregation alias or a group key) and `limit: N`, so the database ranks and cuts the groups, and cite `totalGroups` as how many groups existed before the cut.

## Done when

- Both lines are in the skill; the generated `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts` and the skills reference page are regenerated.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` row has no headroom, so the line pays for itself in the same file (ruling record 6513306068, letter B).
- Text-only change to served skill text: `Clause-②: no` (seat ruling kept by seat 1).

## Order

Tier H (`skills/**`). Starts after PR #35179 and PR #35193 merge, and after the maintainer's ruling on #35137's bound is recorded there (the wording above fits option A; recheck it against the ruling). Shares the file with #35158; whichever runs second re-measures the ratchet row.
